comment: This is long overdue. Delivery workers get injured on the road with zero cover. Fully support.
Good in principle but small restaurants will bear the cost and may shut down. Who pays for it?
The platforms will just cut worker pay to fund it. Net zero for the workers.
Totally back this move our delivery boys have no safety net at all
Please define gig worker clearly. Part timers and students may get excluded.
Insurance is a basic right for anyone doing risky road work. Strongly in favour.
This will raise delivery charges for customers. Think about the common man too.
Who will actually enforce this? Rules exist on paper but nobody checks.
Great step for worker welfare. Should have happened years ago.
